name: setup-node
description: Setup Node.js and npm for CI jobs.

node-version.description: Node.js version to set up. Defaults to version specified in package.json or 24.

options.description: Additional arguments to pass to the install command. includes --no-progress and --workspaces by default.

bare.description: If true, skips the `npm ci` step. Useful for actions that only need Node.js and npm available, but not the project's dependencies.
